title: 哈姆雷特 1-1 城牆亡魂
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, cold gothic atmosphere
characters: Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt

panels.prompt: very wide establishing shot of Elsinore castle on a sea cliff at midnight, sea mist rolling over the battlements, a single torch flickering on the wall walk, cold moonlight through torn clouds

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 丹麥，艾辛諾爾城堡。老王駕崩不滿兩月，王弟已戴上王冠，娶了王后。
dialogue.en: Elsinore, Denmark. The old king not two months dead; his brother now wears the crown, and has married the queen.

panels.prompt: on the dark battlements, sentinel Francisco in a heavy hooded cloak gripping a spear, spinning around startled toward an approaching torch, sentinel Barnardo emerging from the mist with halberd raised

dialogue.speaker: 弗蘭西斯柯
dialogue.text: 不，你先回答我！站住，報上名來！
dialogue.en: Nay, answer me: stand, and unfold yourself.

panels.prompt: sentinel Francisco in a heavy hooded cloak hunching his shoulders against the cold as he hands over the watch, breath visible in the freezing air, sentinel Barnardo with halberd standing guard

dialogue.speaker: 弗蘭西斯柯
dialogue.text: 謝謝你來換班。天冷得厲害，我心裡也發慌。這裡靜得連一隻老鼠都不動。
dialogue.en: For this relief much thanks: 'tis bitter cold, and I am sick at heart. Not a mouse stirring.

panels.prompt: {characters} arriving on the battlements with sentinel Marcellus carrying a halberd, Horatio smiling skeptically with folded arms, torchlight on stone crenellations

dialogue.speaker: 馬西勒斯
dialogue.text: 霍拉旭說那不過是我們的幻想。

panels.prompt: sentinel Barnardo pointing up past the crenellations at a bright lone star in the black sky, the others leaning in to listen, low camp-fire glow on their faces

dialogue.speaker: 勃那多
dialogue.text: 就在昨天晚上——那顆星剛移到現在的位置，鐘敲一點的時候——
dialogue.en: Last night of all, when yond same star that's westward from the pole... The bell then beating one—

panels.prompt: the Ghost of old King Hamlet, a towering spectral king in full plate armour with the visor raised, a long grey beard, hollow eyes, a faint cold blue glow around his translucent form, materializing out of the sea mist on the battlements, the three men recoiling in terror, torch guttering

dialogue.speaker: 馬西勒斯
dialogue.en: Peace, break thee off; look, where it comes again!

panels.prompt: wide shot along the wall walk, a towering blue-glowing armoured silhouette at the far parapet half-dissolved in sea mist, and facing it Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt, his scholar's gown whipping in the wind as he strides forward with one open hand raised high, the two cloaked sentinels crouched behind the crenellations between them

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 你是什麼東西——竟敢僭用先王的形貌，披著他生前的戰甲，在深夜裡遊行？憑著上天的名義，我命令你開口！
dialogue.en: What art thou that usurp'st this time of night, together with that fair and warlike form in which the majesty of buried Denmark did sometimes march? By heaven I charge thee, speak!

panels.prompt: the Ghost of old King Hamlet, a towering spectral king in full plate armour with the visor raised, a long grey beard, hollow eyes, a faint cold blue glow around his translucent form, turning away in offended silence and striding into the mist along the wall walk

dialogue.speaker: 馬西勒斯
dialogue.en: It is offended... See, it stalks away!

dialogue.speaker: 勃那多
dialogue.text: 怎麼樣，霍拉旭？你在發抖，臉色發白。這總不只是幻想吧？
dialogue.en: How now, Horatio! You tremble and look pale. Is not this something more than fantasy?

panels.prompt: three men crowded along the parapet peering out into the drifting sea mist where the ghost vanished, Horatio, a sober young scholar in a plain dark scholar's gown with a high collar, short neatly combed brown hair, a small leather book at his belt gripping the cold stone with both hands, a sentinel lifting a torch high overhead, the flame streaming sideways

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 要不是我親眼看見，我死也不肯相信。那分明是先王——連盔甲都跟他生前一模一樣。這預示著國家將有一場大變故。
dialogue.en: Before my God, I might not this believe without the sensible and true avouch of mine own eyes. Such was the very armour he had on... This bodes some strange eruption to our state.

panels.prompt: the Ghost of old King Hamlet, a towering spectral king in full plate armour with the visor raised, a long grey beard, hollow eyes, a faint cold blue glow around his translucent form, reappearing with arms spread wide as if about to speak, Horatio lunging toward it, a rooster crowing on a distant rooftop silhouette

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 站住！說話呀！我命令你，說話！
dialogue.en: Stay! speak, speak! I charge thee, speak!

panels.prompt: wide shot of dawn breaking over the sea cliffs beyond the battlements, warm first light spilling across the dew on a high eastern hill, the night mist dissolving, three small figures on the wall

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 雞一叫，它就像罪人聽見傳喚一樣消失了。瞧，清晨披著赤褐色的外衣，已經踏著露水，走上東邊的山頭。
dialogue.en: It faded on the crowing of the cock. But, look, the morn, in russet mantle clad, walks o'er the dew of yon high eastward hill.

quote.text: 清晨披著赤褐色的外衣，踏著露水走來
quote.en: The morn, in russet mantle clad, walks o'er the dew.

panels.prompt: morning action shot on the battlements, {characters} fastening his cloak against the dawn wind as he turns to the two weary sentinels shouldering their halberds at the end of the watch, gulls wheeling around the tower behind them

dialogue.speaker: 霍拉旭
dialogue.text: 把昨晚的事告訴年輕的哈姆雷特吧。我用性命打賭——這鬼魂對我們不開口，見了他一定會說話。
dialogue.en: Let us impart what we have seen to-night unto young Hamlet; for, upon my life, this spirit, dumb to us, will speak to him.
